import re
pairs=[]
for r in records:
 m=r.get('message',{})
 if m.get('role')!='user': continue
 text=''.join(c.get('text','') for c in m.get('content',[]) if c.get('type')=='text')
 for n,ih,iw,igr,oh,ow,ogr in re.findall(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n)+)Demo pair \1 output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n)+)',text):
  parse=lambda s:[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in s.strip().splitlines()]
